item.title: Help with sus cycle
item.description: Sus is terrible and breaks down at varying rates, 1st choice should be Cypionate and bring suspended in oil takes 7-8 days, 2nd choice Enthanate which breaks down in 6-7 days. Susamix or Sustagen what ever it’s called is a mix of 4 or 5 different types of Testosterone which all break down in different rates. Hope that helps, FYI I pin 0.5ml of T Cypionate every other. More frequent needles is aich better solution that 2 times a week IMO
